name: Natsuki Akito
source:
The protagonist of the game. A normal company employee. Bachelor, and has no girlfriend. As he lost both parents, his only family left is his older brother. 

For himself, he can't do anything seriously, but for others, he'll give his all. An extremely softhearted person.

After his brother married Miyuri, the woman he loves, he quit university and left his hometown. 

He works with undivided attention to try and forget Miyuri, but even until now he still has lingering affection towards her. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.alicesoft.com/tsumamigui3/chara/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
